correctness.rationale: PASS: For finite connected simple bipartite diameter-exactly-four graphs without 4- or 6-cycles, opposite-side distances are 1 or 3; same-side distances are 2 or 4. At threshold 3 the flag complex is literally L_A*L_B. A same-side clique of size >=3 with pairwise distinct centers would give a 6-cycle; uniqueness of centers is from no 4-cycles. The block-simplex expansion with separate apex for each neighbor center collapses both to L_A and to original G (descending free-face order), including leaves/forest case. Consequently L_A and L_B have homotopy type of G and K_3 ≃ Σ(G∧G) ≃ wedge^{b²}S³, b=e-n+1. Adamaszek 2011 Prop 2.2 at r=2 requires girth>=7, so K_2 collapses to K_1 and actual inclusion preserves integral H1; K_4 is full simplex. The barcodes n-1 [0,1) in H0, b [1,3) in H1, b² [3,4) in H3 follow with integral free groups; no torsion or extrapolation. Independent exact first-principles GQ(2,2) duad-syntheme reconstruction gives both factors (15 vertices,45 edges,15 triangles), each 16 loops, hence 256 three-spheres. For order (s,t), incidence counts n=(st+1)(s+t+2), e=(st+1)(s+1)(t+1), yielding b=s²t²; q=3 gives 6561. No equivariant statement is claimed.
